questions.question: A technician is working near a running engine. Which item must be kept clear of belts and pulleys?
questions.explanation: Loose clothing can become caught in moving engine parts and cause serious injury. ---

questions.category: Task 2 — Uses Tools, Equipment and Documentation
questions.question: Which tool is used to tighten a fastener to specification?
questions.explanation: A torque wrench applies a controlled tightening force. ---

questions.question: An engine has low compression on one cylinder. What test can help locate the leakage?
questions.explanation: A cylinder leakage test helps identify leakage through valves, rings, or head gasket. ---

questions.question: When replacing a timing belt, why must timing marks be aligned?
questions.explanation: Incorrect valve timing can cause poor running or engine damage. ---

questions.category: Task 6 — Diagnoses Gasoline Engine Support Systems
questions.question: High positive fuel trim usually means the PCM is:
questions.explanation: Positive fuel trim shows the PCM is correcting a lean condition by adding fuel. ---
